File size derivation:
- After uploading 60 files, you're 100GB over the 2TB limit.
- 2TB = 2,000GB. So 60 files total ≈ 2,100GB.
- Each file ≈ 2,100GB / 60 = 35GB.

Total need:
- Total files: 60 already uploaded + 980 more = 1,040 files.
- Total storage ≈ 1,040 × 35GB = 36,400GB = 36.4TB.

Minimum plan to store all files:
- Standard: 2TB (insufficient)
- Plus: 10TB (insufficient)
- Premium: 50TB (sufficient)
Conclusion: Premium is the minimum plan that can store all files.

Next: Compute the additional monthly cost over Standard, and distribute it across the files that exceed the Standard plan limit. Standard can hold floor(2,000GB / 35GB) = floor(57.14) = 57 files. Over-limit files: 1,040 − 57 = 983.
